senses.gloss:
m. (-दः)
A Veda, the generic term for the sacred writings or scripture of the Hindus; supposed to have been revealed by BRAHMĀ, and after being preserved by tradition for a considerable period, to have been arranged in the present form by VYĀSA; the principal Vedas are three in number, the Ṛc, Yajus, and Sāma, to which a fourth, the Atharva, is usually added, and the Itihāsa and Purāṇas, or ancient history and mythology, are sometimes considered as a fifth.
2 Metre.
3 Gloss, comment, explanation.
4 Knowledge.
5 VIṢṆU.
E.
विद to know (duty and religion from it). aff. घञ्.

m. (-कः)
ŚIVA.
E.
वेद the Vedas, कुल race, ढक् aff.

m. (-र्भः)
1 BRAHMĀ.
2 A Brahman, a man of the sacerdotal tribe.
E.
वेद the Vedas, and गर्भ embryo or womb, figuratively for origin.

f. (-प्तिः)
The preservation of the Vedas by the Brahmanical tribe.
E.
वेद a Veda, and गुप्ति concealment.

m. (-ज्ञः)
A Brahman skilled in the Vedas.
E.
वेद, and ज्ञ who knows.

m. (-ण्डः)
An elephant.

n. (-त्त्वं)
The true doctrine or substance of the Vedas.
E.
वेद, and तत्त्व truth.

nf. (-यं-यी)
The three first Vedas.
E.
वेद, and त्रय triad.

nf. (-नं-ना)
1 Sensation, perception, knowledge conveyed by the senses.
2 Pain, smart, agony.
3 Knowledge.
4 The ceremony of holding the ends of a mantle, to be observed by a Śūdra female, on her marriage with a man of either of the first three classes.
5 Presenting, delivering.
f. (-नी)
The true skin or cutis.
E.
विद to know, &c., युच् aff.

m. (-दः)
Sound of chaunting or repeating the Vedas.
E.
वेद, and नाद sound.

m. (-कः)
1 An atheist, a disbeliever.
2 A Jaina or Bauddha, or any seceder from the belief of the divine origin and character of the Vedas.
E.
वेद scripture, and निन्दक defaming, disrespecting.

f. (-न्दा)
Reviling the Vedas, heresy, disbelief.
E.
वेद, and निन्दा blame.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be known or perceived.
2 To be, or to be made known.
E.
विद to know, अनीयर् aff.

m. (-गः)
A Brahman skilled in the Vedas.
E.
वेद the Veda, and पारग who crosses.

n. (-ण्यं)
The sanctity of the Vedas.
E.
वेद, and पुण्य holiness.

f. (-ता)
The mystical prayer or Gāyatrī, personified as the mother or source of the Vedas.
E.
वेद, and मातृ mother.

f. (-ख्या)
A sort of insect, the winged bug.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Who or what knows or obtains.
E.
विद to know, श aff.

n. (-णं)
The conservation of the Vedas, as a duty of the Brahmanical order.
E.
वेद a Veda, and रक्षण preserving.

n. (-नं)
A text of the Veda.
E.
वेद, and वचन dictum.

n. (-क्यं)
Text of the Veda.
E.
वेद, and वाक्य sentence.

m. (-सः)
A Brahman.
E.
वेद a Veda, and वास abode.

m. (-विद् or वित्)
A Brahman versed in the Vedas.
E.
वेद the Vedas, and विद to know, क्विप् aff.

m. (-द्वान्)
A Brahman learned in the Vedas.
E.
वेद, and विद्वस् a learned man.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Taught or declared in the Vedas, scriptural.
E.
वेद, and विहित said.

n. (-त्तं)
The doctrine of the Vedas.
E.
वेद, and वृत्त done.

m. (-सः)
The Muni VYĀSA.
E.
वेद the Vedas, वि and आङ् severally, before अस to throw or place, aff. घञ्, the compiler and arranger of the Vedas; he having first collected and arranged the Hindu scriptures into the four parts, in which they at present exist.

m. (-ब्दः)
A word or term in the Vedas.
E.
वेद, and शब्द a sound.

n. (-स्रं)
The Vedas or any part of them.
E.
वेद, and शास्त्र an inspired writing, a scripture.

f. (-ता)
A collection of the formulæ of the Vedas.
E.
वेद, and संहिता a compendium.

m. (-दाः)
The Vedas collectively.
E.
विद to know, असुन् aff.

m. (-सः)
Discontinuing the ritual of the Vedas.
E.
वेद, and सन्न्यास relinquishing.

m. (-कः)
The religious ascetic or member of the fourth order, who discontinues the ritual of the Vedas.
E.
वेद, सन्न्यास, and ठक् aff.; also with इनि, वेदसन्न्यासिन्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Conformable to the Vedas.
E.
वेद, and सम्मत concurrent.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A sacred science, considered as subordinate to, and in some sense, a part of the Vedas: six sciences come under this denomination; Śīkṣā, or the science of pronunciation and articulation; Kalpa the detail of religious ceremonies; Vyākaraṇa, or grammar; Candas, prosody; Jyotiṣ, or astronomy; and Nirukti, or the explanation of the difficult or obscure words and phrases that occur in the Vedas.
E.
वेद the Vedas, and अङ्ग a member.

n. (-र्णं)
The mystical name of GOD.
E.
वेद the Vedas, आदि first, and वर्ण letter.

m. (-मः)
Perusal or study of the Vedas.
E.
वेद, and अधिगम going over or through.

n. (-नं)
Study of the Vedas.
E.
वेद, and अध्ययन reading.

m. (-यी)
A student of the Vedas.
E.
वेद, and अध्ययिन् who reads.

m. (-कः)
A teacher of the Vedas.
E.
वेद, and अध्यापक teacher.

n. (-नं)
Teaching the Vedas.
E.
वेद, and अध्यापन teaching.

m. (-न्तः)
The theological part of the Vedas; considered collectively it is contained in the many numerous passages or chapters of the Vedas termed Upaniṣads, which inculcate an abstract and speculative monotheistical worship, and these have been further explained and illustrated by later writers: the founder of the school is VYĀSA, and subsequently ŚAṂKARĀCĀRYA is its most eminent teacher.
E.
वेद the Vedas, and अन्त end, sum, scope or substance.

m. (-गः)
A Vedāntī.
E.
वेदान्त, and ग who goes over.

m. (-ज्ञः)
A Vedāntī.
E.
वेदान्त, and ज्ञ who knows.

m. (-न्ती)
A Vedāntī, a follower of the Vedānta philosophy.
E.
वेदान्त the theism of the Vedas, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Derived from or produced by the Vedānta.
E.
वेदान्त, and उपगत derived from.

m. (-सः)
1 The repetition of the mystical syllable Om.
2 Study of scripture.
E.
वेद the Vedas, and अभ्यास exercise.

m. (-रः)
A chameleon, a lizard.

f. (-दिः-दी)
1 Ground for placing the vessels used at an oblation, or for binding the victim, or lighting the sacrificial fire; it is more or less raised and of various shapes; an altar, &c.
2 A quadrangular spot in the court-yard of a temple or palace, usually furnished with a raised floor or seat, and covered with a roof supported by pillars: see वितर्दि.
3 A seal ring.
m. (-दिः)
A Paṇḍita, a teacher.
f. (-दिः)
A name of SARASVATĪ, the wife of BRAHMĀ.
E.
विद to know, &c. Uṇādi aff. इन्, and ङीष् optionally added in the fem. form.

f. (-का)
1 A quadrangular open shed in the middle of a court yard, erected for various purposes: see वितर्द्दि.
2 Ground prepared for sacrificial ceremonies, a rude kind of altar.
E.
कन् added to the last.

f. (-जा)
DRAUPADĪ, the sister and wife of the Pāṇḍus.
E.
वेदि an altar, and ज born; born from sacrificial fire.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Set forth, represented, made known.
E.
विद to know, causal form, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 To be known or ascertained.
2 To be made known, to be explained or expounded.
E.
विद to know, causal form, aff. तव्यर्.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Wise, learned.
E.
विद to know, तृच् aff., with the augment इट्.

n. (-त्वं)
Knowledge, experience.
E.
वेदिन् who knows, त्व aff.; also with तल्, वेदिता.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Who or what knows.
m. (-दी)
1 A Paṇḍita, a learned Brahman, a teacher.
2 BRAHMĀ.
n. (-दि)
A plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.)
E.
विद to know, घिनुण् aff.

m. (-शः)
BRAHMĀ.
E.
वेदी SARASVATĪ, and ईश lord.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Scriptural, taught or declared in the Vedas.
E.
वेद the Vedas, and उक्त said.

m. (-यः)
SŪRYA, or the sun.
E.
वेद the Veda, (the Sāma Veda,) and उदय rise, origin; being said to have proceeded from the sun.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Taught in the Vedas, scriptural.
E.
वेद the Vedas, and उदित spoken, from वद to speak, with क्त aff.

n. (-णं)
A subordinate branch of the study of the Vedas: see वेदाङ्ग.
E.
वेद, and उपकरण implement.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
1 To be known or ascertained.
2 To be explained or taught.
E.
विद to know, ण्यत् aff.
